description: The org's plan and each limit with how much is used: workspaces, connected accounts, people (open invitations count), posts made this month, media storage in GB, active API keys, competitors watched, new competitor-post studies this month (a post someone already studied is free) and What works readouts this month. A null cap means no limit. features says which paid-plan tools the plan has (custom link page design, link page tests and weekly tuning, client approval links, shared and scheduled reports, CSV import, evergreen posts); dm_rule_cap is how many keyword DM rules it keeps at once and history_days how far back insights, link page numbers and reports reach (null: no limit). Anything that would pass a cap or needs a missing feature fails with PLAN_LIMIT: don't retry it; tell the person. billing says whether a paid plan is active and what bigger plans cost; only the space's owner can buy one, in the app's Settings, never through an agent.
name: plan_get
title: Plan and limits
